label: Caption - Texture Fill
description: Caption whose letters are filled with a drifting textured gradient (background-clip text) while the words scale and unblur into place.

primary.label: Texture Primary
primary.description: Primary color of the textured gradient fill (maps to --mp-color-primary).

accent.label: Texture Accent
accent.description: Accent color of the textured gradient fill (maps to --mp-color-accent).
